 Follow Captain investigated after cruise liner hits two container ships
 DPA Mon, October 26, 2026 at 2:19 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The "Mein Schiff 3" is docked at Columbuskaje after having collided with two container ships the day before amid stormy weather. (is associated with: «Captain investigated after cruise liner hits two container ships») Sina Schuldt/dpa Following a shipping accident in the northern German port of Bremerhaven, police are investigating the captain of the TUI cruise ship Mein Schiff 3 (My Ship 3).
 A police spokeswoman stated on Monday that administrative offence proceedings had been initiated against him: "Investigations are under way to determine whether he breached his duty of care."
 The police did not initially provide any further details, such as exactly what the alleged breach of duty of care relates to.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The news had initially been reported by broadcaster RTL.
 A strong gust of wind caused the cruise ship carrying more than 3,300 passengers and crew to collide with two container vessels while leaving the port of Bremerhaven, police said, sharing new details about Sunday's accident.
 Mein Schiff 3 was departing for the Canary Islands on Sunday evening when a gust of wind pushed it towards two container ships moored alongside the harbour wall, police said.
 One container ship was severely damaged by the collision, while the other one sustained slight damage, according to police. The cruise ship was also severely damaged, with images showing that the ship's on-board lifeboats were crushed.
 Advertisement Advertisement "The collision tore open the port side of the large container ship over a length of several metres and deformed the container guides," police said.
 No one was injured on any of the three ships and no water entered the vessels, as the damage occurred a few metres above water level, according to police.
 Mein Schiff 3 returned to the cruise ship terminal following the collision and all three vessels have been barred from leaving the port.
 The police estimate the damage to property to run into millions.
 The smaller container ship sustained minor damage, whilst the larger one sustained significant damage. The TUI ship was also significantly damaged.
 Advertisement Advertisement TUI Cruises confirmed on Monday that it was cancelling the cruise in light of the crash. According to the operator, the cruise ship requires repair work at a shipyard.
 According to TUI, 2,428 passengers and 922 crew members were on board the cruise ship at the time.
 An eyewitness video verified by dpa shows the cruise ship leaving the port accompanied by tugboats in choppy waters.
 The vessel can be seen moving increasingly close to a container ship moored alongside the harbour wall before striking it.
 "I think that's it for the trip," a woman can be heard saying in the clip.
 The "Mein Schiff 3" is docked at the Columbuskaje. The cruise ship had collided with two container ships the day before amid stormy weather. (is associated with: «Captain investigated after cruise liner hits two container ships») Sina Schuldt/dpa
